ollama.description: Local Ollama inference — zero API cost, no cloud egress. `baseUrl` below is this machine's documented fallback, overridable per-host with the OLLAMA_BASE_URL env var (see scripts/ai-utils.mjs) so the pre-push hook keeps working on a host with a different bind address. On this Mac, Ollama is bound only to its Tailscale IP, not localhost (~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.ollama.tailscale.plist sets OLLAMA_HOST=100.112.223.16:11434, not 0.0.0.0), so traffic to it transits the Tailscale mesh rather than loopback.

local.description: Local Ollama models — pre-push hook only (not available in CI). Repository invariants loaded via system prompt.

fast.description: Fastest cloud models — CI fallback and offline pre-push fallback

pro.description: Deep reasoning cloud models — for protocol state machine validation, invariant proofs, and architectural audits
